---
title: "Indicators"
page-layout: full
execute:
  echo: false
---

Explore the indicators collected by the AHEAD project. Use the search box or column filters to find resources by name, category or keyword.


```{r}
library(data.table)
library(rjson)
library(reactable)

indicators_dir <- "../indicators/"

fls <- list.files(
  indicators_dir,
  full.names = TRUE,
  pattern = "\\.json$"
)

indicators_dt <- lapply(fls, function(file) {

  json_data <- file |>
    readLines(warn = FALSE) |>
    paste(collapse = "") |>
    fromJSON()

  json_data$keywords <- paste(
    json_data$keywords,
    collapse = ", "
  )

  json_data
}) |>
  rbindlist(
    idcol = "id",
    use.names = TRUE,
    fill = TRUE
  )

reactable(
  indicators_dt,

  searchable = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  sortable = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  striped = FALSE,
  bordered = TRUE,

  defaultPageSize = 15,
  pageSizeOptions = c(10, 15, 25, 50),
  paginationType = "jump",

  fullWidth = TRUE,
  compact = FALSE,

  defaultColDef = colDef(
    resizable = TRUE,
    minWidth = 140,
    headerStyle = list(
      background = "#f4f2ff",
      color = "#30256f",
      fontWeight = "700",
      borderBottom = "3px solid #5544cc",
      padding = "12px"
    ),
    style = list(
      padding = "12px",
      whiteSpace = "normal",
      lineHeight = "1.45",
      verticalAlign = "top"
    )
  ),

  columns = list(
    id = colDef(
      name = "ID",
      width = 70,
      minWidth = 70,
      align = "center",
      sticky = "left",
      headerStyle = list(
        background = "#5544cc",
        color = "white",
        fontWeight = "700",
        borderBottom = "3px solid #5544cc"
      ),
      style = list(
        background = "white",
        fontWeight = "700",
        color = "#5544cc"
      )
    ),

    keywords = colDef(
      name = "Keywords",
      minWidth = 240,
      style = list(
        fontSize = "0.82rem",
        color = "#5544cc"
      )
    )
  ),

  theme = reactableTheme(
    borderColor = "#dedbea",
    highlightColor = "#f4f2ff",
    cellPadding = "10px 12px",

    style = list(
      fontFamily = "Comfortaa, sans-serif",
      fontSize = "0.86rem"
    ),

    searchInputStyle = list(
      width = "280px",
      border = "1px solid #c9c3e5",
      borderRadius = "8px",
      padding = "9px 12px"
    ),

    selectStyle = list(
      border = "1px solid #c9c3e5",
      borderRadius = "8px",
      padding = "6px"
    ),

    paginationStyle = list(
      marginTop = "18px"
    )
  )
)
```
